changes: New Dark theme: near-black panels with violet accents. Choose it under Shared preferences → Shared appearance → Theme or type /hg theme dark.
The target marker's ring takes your theme's colour, such as violet in Dark or copper in Ember. Custom ring colours are kept; choose Gold again to keep a gold ring.
WoW Forever: Darkspear Islands is recognized, with 60-second base capture timers, graveyard waves every 30 seconds and base callouts.
WoW Forever: Alterac Valley tower and graveyard capture timers count down 300 seconds instead of 240.
notice: Fully quit and restart WoW after updating: this release adds new addon files. CurseForge files may still be in moderation.
